subject: Computer Science

internalBreakdown.component: Lab test: Python program (60% logic, 20% documentation, 20% code quality)

textbooks: Support material on the CBSE website
notes: The document states learning outcomes for the whole course, recorded on the first chapter of each unit.

chapters.name: Computer System and Software
topics: Basic computer organisation: hardware, software, input and output devices, CPU
Memory: primary, cache, secondary; units of memory (bit to PB)
Types of software: system software (OS, utilities, device drivers), programming tools and language translators (assembler, compiler, interpreter), application software
Operating system: functions and user interface
outcomes: Develop a basic understanding of computer systems: architecture and operating system

chapters.name: Boolean Logic
topics: NOT, AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR
Truth tables and De Morgan's laws
Logic circuits

chapters.name: Number Systems and Encoding
topics: Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal; conversion between number systems
Encoding schemes: ASCII, ISCII, Unicode (UTF8, UTF32)

chapters.name: Introduction to Problem Solving
topics: Steps: analysing the problem, developing an algorithm, coding, testing and debugging
Algorithms as flowchart and pseudocode
Decomposition

chapters.name: Getting Started with Python
topics: Features of Python; hello world; interactive and script mode
Character set; tokens: keyword, identifier, literal, operator, punctuator
Variables, l-value and r-value, comments

chapters.name: Data Types, Operators and Expressions
topics: Number (integer, float, complex), boolean, sequence (string, list, tuple), None, mapping (dictionary); mutable and immutable types
Arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment, augmented assignment, identity and membership operators
Precedence, expression evaluation, explicit and implicit type conversion, console input and output
Syntax, logical and run-time errors

chapters.name: Flow of Control
topics: Indentation; sequential, conditional and iterative flow
if, if-else, if-elif-else with flowcharts: absolute value, sort 3 numbers, divisibility
for loop, range(), while loop, break and continue, nested loops: patterns, series, factorial

chapters.name: Strings
topics: Concatenation, repetition, membership and slicing; traversal

Built-in methods: len, capitalize, title, lower, upper, count, find, index, endswith, startswith, isalnum, isalpha, isdigit, islower, isupper, isspace, lstrip, rstrip, strip, replace, join, partition, split

chapters.name: Lists
topics: Indexing, list operations, traversal
Methods: len, list, append, extend, insert, count, index, remove, pop, reverse, sort, sorted, min, max, sum
Nested lists; programs: max, min, mean; linear search; frequency of elements

chapters.name: Tuples
topics: Indexing, tuple operations; len, tuple, count, index, sorted, min, max, sum
Tuple assignment, nested tuple; programs: min, max, mean, linear search, frequency

chapters.name: Dictionaries
topics: Accessing items by key; mutability; traversal
Methods: len, dict, keys, values, items, get, update, del, clear, fromkeys, copy, pop, popitem, setdefault, max, min, sorted
Programs: character frequency in a string; employee salary dictionary

chapters.name: Python Modules
topics: import and from statements
math: pi, e, sqrt, ceil, floor, pow, fabs, sin, cos, tan
random: random, randint, randrange
statistics: mean, median, mode

chapters.name: Digital Footprints and Digital Society
topics: Digital footprints
Netizen etiquettes: net, communication and social media
outcomes: Explain cyber ethics, cyber safety and cybercrime
Understand the value of technology in societies, with consideration of gender and disability issues

chapters.name: Data Protection and Intellectual Property
topics: IPR: copyright, patent, trademark; violations: plagiarism, copyright and trademark infringement
Open source software and licensing: Creative Commons, GPL, Apache

chapters.name: Cyber Crime and Cyber Safety
topics: Hacking, eavesdropping, phishing and fraud emails, ransomware, cyber trolls, cyber bullying
Safe browsing, identity protection, confidentiality
Malware: viruses, trojans, adware
Information Technology Act

chapters.name: Technology and Society
topics: E-waste management
Gender and disability issues while teaching and using computers
